$comment: Documented things the library deliberately does not model, each with a reason. An entry without 'scope' allow-lists a whole operation (no EndpointTable descriptor, no models yet): delete it when the family lands, CoverageTests fails on stale entries. 'scope' request/response/callback plus 'field' allow-lists one property ('*' for all of them); 'endpoint' '*' means every operation; 'method' narrows an operation entry where a path is documented with both POST and PATCH; a response entry with 'fixture' makes ResponseModelTests deserialise that fixture (under test/Scott.Mail.Smtp2Go.Tests.Shared/Fixtures) instead of the docs example, for pages whose example is known to be wrong.
